title: the verdict contract reads a far box's chart berths by their own names
intention: A chart berth ref recorded on any box resolves on this one by its own file name, at one address in the chain tool, so the verdict gate reads a ticket charted on akiendell.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux: after 1e99a571dd6d landed, a4892e762b70's verdict gate answered FileNotFoundError on validate_ref C:\Users\akien\.cairn\devices\chart\0\packets\validate-20261113T005908-be563e43b341.json, and the close kicked it to FIXME. verdict_contract._read_chain opens validate_ref and the packet's hypothesize_ref with a bare open(), although CairnCommons/berths/chart/ holds both copies.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: a verdict is a measurement, and a ticket built on another box must be measurable here. e8fb6bcd23c5 (the commons mirror) is the design this reads.
how: Add chain.resolve_berth(ref, *, mirror=None) after carry_berth in cairn/tools/chain/chain.py: the ref when it is a file here, else <mirror>/<PureWindowsPath(ref).name>, else None. verdict_contract._read_chain opens both refs through _open_ref, which falls back to the recorded path so its error stays unchanged. sail.validate_path calls resolve_berth. Proof: cairn/tools/chain/proofs/test_a_far_box_berth_ref_resolves_by_its_name.py, keyed PROVES '4e84a96955a1' clauses 1-2.

outcomes.claim: chain.resolve_berth returns a local file as itself, a Windows-recorded or absent posix ref's commons copy by its own name, and None when neither is a file

verdict_contract.unanswered over a chain whose validate_ref and hypothesize_ref are Windows-recorded, both copies in the commons mirror, every criterion passed and every hypothesis disposed, returns []

constraints: sail.validate_path keeps its contract and calls chain.resolve_berth; the d86b4e5ae614 and 1e99a571dd6d teeth in cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_sail_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py stand unchanged.
A ref found in neither place opens as recorded, so the refusal 'the claiming chain cannot be read from validate_ref' is unchanged.

out: cairn/devices/codemother (the verdict gate composes verdict_contract unchanged)
